mapper.sql: select s.id, s.player_id, s.season, s.competition, s.appearances, s.starts, s.minutes_played, s.goals, s.assists, s.yellow_cards, s.red_cards, s.stat_as_of, s.source_url, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, p.name_cn as player_name, p.avatar_url, p.jersey_number, IFNULL(p.position, '未知') as position, p.nationality, IFNULL(p.status, '未知') as player_status from football_player_season_stat s left join football_player p on s.player_id = p.id
mapper.select: select m.season, m.competition_name as competition, count(1) as matchCount from football_match m where m.del_flag = '0' and m.status = 1 and m.home_score is not null and m.away_score is not null and exists ( select 1 from football_player_season_stat s where s.season = m.season and s.competition = m.competition_name ) and m.season = #{season} and m.competition_name = #{competition} group by m.season, m.competition_name order by m.season desc, m.competition_name
select id, name_cn as nameCn, avatar_url as avatarUrl, jersey_number as jerseyNumber, position from football_player where del_flag = '0' and status = '活跃' order by jersey_number
